Cuts HSA facility density into the five published categories, using quartiles from the final cohort.

The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/define_exposure.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/define_exposure.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/functions.R)
-   [`R/create_cohort.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/create_cohort.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}

```

## Cut points

The 25th, 50th and 75th percentiles of density among all patients, zeros included, as in the original code. The paper reports 1.36, 1.95 and 2.76 facilities per 100,000.

#| eval: false
